_comment: Urban Plant ONLY side-dependent ledger map for the Universal Bank Statement classifier. Same mechanism as m-brands.json: when a bank narration contains a counterparty token, use the credit-side ledger for a Receipt and the debit-side ledger for a Payment. An entry may set a fixed "type" (e.g. Contra) to override the Receipt/Payment default — used for the PETTYCASH own-account transfers which were falling to Suspense. Checked ABOVE the DB directory; each ledger is validated against the brand COA at runtime (skipped + falls through if missing). Built from the accountant's reviewed previous output.
